test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.

(Neither of the two have cleared the) aptitude test.

options.text: Neither of two have cleared the
Neither of the two boys have cleared
Neither of the two has cleared the

solution:
The correct sentence is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Neither of two has cleared the'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **original sentence **is **grammatically incorrect **because the subject "Neither of the two" is singular, but** the verb** "have cleared" is in the plural form.
 
• **The verb should** be in agreement with the subject, which requires using the singular form "has cleared."
 
• **Option 4 corrects **this error by using the singular form of the verb, "has cleared," **which agrees **with the singular subject "Neither of the two." Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *'**Neither of the two has cleared the** aptitude test'.*
